integrity: Stationary moments and a sharp parameter sign law are derived analytically; symbolic and independent response-integral checks corroborate the claim. Independent scholarly audit and priority assessment have not been performed.
limitations: Applies to one-dimensional harmonically trapped inertial motion driven by symmetric dichotomous telegraph force with positive damping and flipping, without additive thermal noise. Endpoints are limits and not included; extensions require fresh analysis.
title: Sharp potential–kinetic energy covariance boundary for an inertial run-and-tumble oscillator
